sentences.text: Wpcrl/1167/2023 on 18 August, 2023

Author: Pankaj Purohit
Bench: Manoj Kumar Tiwari, Pankaj Purohit
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders
Sl. or proceedings
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No or directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  WPCRL No. 1167 of 2023  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
(1) Mr. D.N. Sharma, learned counsel for the petitioner.
(2) Mr. J.S. Virk, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State of Uttarakhand.
(3) Mr. M.K. Ray, learned counsel for the respondent no. 4 to 7.
(4) Petitioners have approached this Court for protection.

Earlier petitioner nos. 1 & 2 had filed similar petition, which was disposed of vide order dated 09.06.2022 by directing Senior Superintendent of Police, Udham Singh Nagar to decide, as to whether the protection granted to the petitioners by this Court deserves to be continued any further, or not.

(5) It is contended that pursuant to the said order, passed in WPCRL No. 1104 of 2022, petitioner nos. 1 & 2 were given protection, however, protection was withdrawn in view of subsequent order dated 23.09.2022, whereby earlier order dated 09.06.2022 was recalled.

(6) Perusal of the order dated 23.09.2023 reveals that father and mother of petitioner no. 1 filed an application seeking recall of earlier order on the ground that petitioner no. 1 was minor at the time of filing of WPCRL No. 1104 of 2022.
The said application was allowed, based on the finding recorded by Juvenile Justice Board, Udham Singh Nagar that petitioner no. 1 is a minor and his date of birth is 20.04.2005.

(7) It is not in dispute that father of petitioner no. 1 has filed an FIR on 09.11.2022, which was registered under Sections 363, 366 & 420 of I.P.C. at Police Station, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar.

(8) Learned counsel for petitioners submits that petitioner no. 2 was granted protection from arrest by learned Single Judge in WPCRL No. 36 of 2023, and thereafter, on C-482 Application No. 1095 of WPCRL/1167/2023 on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70046557/
1 2023, filed by petitioner no. 2, further proceedings of SST No. 396 of 2023, pending before the court of Additional Sessions Judge, Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar has been kept in abeyance.
(9) It is further stated that petitioner nos. 1 & 2 married on 09.02.2022, which is duly registered with Registrar Compulsory Registration of Marriages, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar, and petitioner nos. 1 & 2 have now been blessed with a son on 10.03.2023.
The birth certificate of petitioner no. 3 is on record as annexure 4 to the writ petition, in which his date of birth is mentioned as 10.03.2023.

It is further contended by learned counsel for petitioners that petitioners are facing grave threat from private respondents, therefore, they deserves to be provided protection.
(10)
Mr. M.K. Ray, Advocate appearing for private respondents also do not dispute that petitioner no. 1 has attained majority on 20.04.2023.
(11) Since both petitioner nos. 1 & 2 are major and they are living together as husband and wife,

though against the wish of private respondents, however, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Lata Singh Vs. State of U.P. and Another; 2006 (5) SCC 475, we are inclined to grant protection to the petitioners.

entities.text: Lata Singh Vs. State of U.P. and Another; 2006 (5) SCC 475
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
(12) Accordingly, the present writ petition is disposed of with direction to the Station House Officer,
P.S. Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar to provide protection to the petitioners for a period of eight weeks and ensure that no harm is caused to them during this period.
Upon expiry of eight weeks, concerned SHO shall make assessment of threat perception to the petitioners, and provide protection to them, if needed, for such further period, as is felt necessary.

(13) Let a certified copy of this order be supplied to learned counsel for the petitioners, today itself,
as per rules.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 18.08.2023
